items.name: log-parser
items.description: Zero-dependency Python log parser that detects each line's format for you. Handles Apache/Nginx combined and common, JSON lines, fixed-field and generic app logs in one pass. Normalises timestamps to UTC, writes a CSV, and summarises traffic, error rates, broken links and scanner probes. Fully tested.
